models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light NE flow over the islands, 6-11 kt and seas under 2 ft - but nothing yet covers the 4 Oct trip dates.
briefing.synopsis: A gentle north-to-northeast flow is sitting over the Aeolians: consensus winds 6-11 kt at the outer islands (Stromboli 10.9 kt from 033 at midday 26 Sep, Panarea 10.2 kt from 017) and 3-7 kt in the lee at Portorosa, with total waves 1.0-2.2 ft and swell 0.8-1.7 ft. ECMWF IFS and AIFS (both 25 Sep 18Z) and ICON-2i (26 Sep 00Z) agree the gradient collapses overnight into 28 Sep - Lipari down to 0.9 kt at 06:00, Panarea 1.3 kt, Filicudi 1.5 kt, seas 0.4-0.6 ft. Direction backs and veers through N and NW as the flow goes slack. The data in hand runs only to 2 Oct 23:00, two days short of your first leg.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: No fleet berth tonight - the boats are not yet in commission. For reference, the rehearsal scores Portorosa Marina as sheltered on the night of 26 Sep, an enclosed basin with all-round shelter, and with 5.1 kt from 008 and 1.2 ft of sea at 18:00 (IFS 25 Sep 18Z) nothing there is under pressure. Later rehearsal nights all come out sheltered except Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli on 29 Sep, rated workable only because it is open from every direction and depends on it staying calm.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Not applicable seven days out. What the rehearsal shows is that under this pattern a 06:00 departure works easily on every leg - the tightest is Portorosa to Lipari at 8.1 kt, head to wind, so a motor. Treat that as a demonstration of the scoring, not a forecast for 4 October.

passage_notes.note: Rehearsed 27 Sep: 8.1 kt, head to wind, motoring leg, verdict go. Beyond the forecast horizon for the actual date.
Rehearsed 28 Sep: 1.8 kt broad reach, go. Effectively a flat calm - no guide to the trip date.
Rehearsed 29 Sep: 2.8 kt, head to wind, go. Stromboli shelter is the limiting factor, not the passage.
Rehearsed 30 Sep: 2.7 kt run, gusts to 10 kt from a single model's interval maximum in light air - reported, not a caution.
Rehearsed 1 Oct: 5.5 kt broad reach, go.
Rehearsed 2 Oct: 3.4 kt broad reach, go - the last hour the models reach.

cautions: No model run in this payload extends past 2 Oct 23:00. Every trip date from 4 Oct on is unforecast - the rehearsal verdicts are a dry run of the scoring, not a prediction.

Where the models disagree by more than 6 kt it is flagged: Panarea 27 Sep 06:00 spans 7.6-14.5 kt, Lipari the same hour 4.1-10.8 kt, Portorosa 28 Sep 00:00 spans 0.5-7.9 kt, Stromboli 26 Sep 00:00 spans 3.1-9.3 kt. Take those as ranges, not means.
Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli is open from every direction; it only works while it stays calm, and any new swell or northerly fill-in would end it.
Gust figures from ECMWF IFS are interval maxima, so factors of 3x over a 4 kt mean (e.g. Filicudi 22.2 kt gust on 26 Sep 06:00) look alarming and are not instantaneous values.
briefing.confidence_note: Model agreement on the current light pattern is good - stability tracking shows mean wind shifts of only about 1 kt out to 120 h, though direction shifts average 59 degrees at that range - but confidence for the trip dates themselves is simply unavailable, since no run reaches them.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
